metadata.indicator_name: Annual Gross Domestic Product (GDP) by Expenditure at constant prices in National Currency
metadata.area: Annual National Accounts in local currency
metadata.definition:
The Gross Domestic Product (GDP) in constant values/ volume terms is the value of the flow of goods and services in a country at market prices for a base year/reference, which reflects the changes only due to volume variation, isolating those due to price changes. This is measured as the sum of the final demands from the following components: Household Consumption, Government Consumption, Gross Fixed Capital Formation and Net Exports (Exports minus Imports). 

The figures are in local currency according to official sources.
metadata.calculation_methodology: All LAC countries compile their data according to the System of National Accounts (SNA), however, the methodology of calculate of the GDP differs between every country, it is recommended review the methodologies published in every national office.
